fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.validity: 3 months validity, 1 month stay, single entry
fees.notes: Fee published by Afghanistan Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Applications go through the e-consulate portal (econsulate.mfa.gov.af) and are collected at Afghan embassies/consulates. Fees can vary slightly by mission.

fees.name: Tourist e-visa (E-Afghans portal, launched March 2026)
fees.validity: 90 days validity from issue, 30 days stay, single entry, Kabul International Airport entry only
fees.notes: USD 8 non-refundable application fee paid upfront, then USD 120 visa fee plus ~3% payment processing charge (~USD 3.71) after approval; total ~USD 128-132. E-Afghans portal (eafghans.com) is the official application site but was not directly fetchable at time of research; fee fi…

fees.name: Business visa (multiple entry)
fees.validity: 3 months multiple entry at USD 40; 6 months USD 80; 1 year USD 160; 2 years USD 250; 3 years USD 300
fees.notes: Tiered by validity: USD 40 (3-month) to USD 300 (3-year), payable in USD or Afghani equivalent. Extension: USD 15 per month up to one year. Requires business licence, passport copy, bank statements.

fees.name: Arrival visa (Kabul International Airport, invitation-based)
fees.notes: Arrival visas exist but require prior MFA approval and an official invitation; they are not a walk-up tourist VOA. MFA page cites fees per Article 27 of the Travel and Residence Law without publishing an amount, so amount left null.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: up to 72 hours (per general visa-type descriptions)
fees.notes: Transit visa is listed among official visa categories, but no fee amount is published on the MFA type page; amount left null rather than estimated.

AFG.free_visa_notes: Visas are not free in general. Some third-party sources report gratis visas for Indian nationals under reciprocity, but this could not be verified on an official Afghan government source, so it is not recorded as a reciprocity variation. Visit visa (relatives/sports/exhibitions)…

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Fee published by the Embassy of Angola in Washington DC; consular fees can differ by embassy. Proof of subsistence means (~USD 200/day) required.

fees.name: e-Visa / pre-approved visa on arrival (SME e-Visa portal)
fees.notes: Applied via the official SME e-Visa portal (smevisa.gov.ao); pre-approval issued online, visa collected and paid at the border in USD or kwanza. The fee is not published on a publicly accessible official page (third-party sites report ~USD 120), so amount is left null rather tha…

fees.name: Visa on arrival (with online pre-approval)
fees.notes: Paid at dedicated e-Visa counters at the port of entry in USD or kwanza. Amount not verifiable on an official public page (unofficial sources cite USD 120); left null per accuracy rules.

fees.name: Ordinary (business) visa
fees.validity: up to 30 days per stay, extendable
fees.notes: Embassy of Angola (Washington DC) fee for ordinary/business visa for US applicants; processing 5-8 business days. Short-term visa is USD 80 at the same mission.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Requires yellow fever vaccination certificate and proof of onward travel.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Angola visa application centres in some countries (e.g. Nigeria, visa.vfsglobal.com/nga/en/ago); the service fee is set per centre and the page was not publicly accessible to verify an amount. Many other corridors still apply directly to Angolan embassies.

AGO.free_visa_notes: Since late 2023 Angola grants visa-free entry for tourism to citizens of ~98 countries (incl. USA, UK, Canada, EU, China, Russia and others) for up to 30 days per trip and 90 days per calendar year (Presidential Decree 189/23). Confirmed for US citizens by travel.state.gov. Nati…

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa (single entry) via e-visa.al
fees.notes: All Albanian visas are applied for online at e-visa.al; there is no separate e-visa vs sticker fee. Fees are set per nationality by Council of Ministers Decision (VKM) No. 329, dated 29.05.2024 - schedule ranges from gratis (e.g. Algeria, Palestine, China) to EUR 100 (e.g. Belar…

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa (two entries)
fees.notes: Two-entry and multiple-entry fees vary widely by nationality (e.g. Nigeria: EUR 25 single / EUR 40 two-entry / EUR 80 multiple). No single amount applies; see reciprocity_variations and the official VKM 329/2024 schedule.

fees.name: Type A airport transit visa
fees.notes: The VKM 329/2024 schedule lists Type A airport-transit fees per nationality alongside Type C; default EUR 35 where no reciprocity rate exists. Applied via e-visa.al.

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa for business purposes
fees.notes: Albania has no separate business-visa fee; business travel uses the Type C visa at the same nationality-based tariff as tourism.

variations.note: Type C single/two/multiple entry all EUR 15 (apply at Beijing, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul missions via e-visa).
China: short-stay Type C not listed (visa-free for short stays); Type D long-stay visa is gratis.
Single entry EUR 25; two entries EUR 40; multiple entries EUR 80.
Single entry EUR 20; two/multiple entries EUR 35.
Single, two and multiple entries all EUR 30.

Single entry EUR 30; two/multiple entries EUR 50. (Russians are visa-free during the summer season under Albania's seasonal exemption when in force.)
US, UK and Canadian citizens do not require a visa for short stays (not in the visa-required schedule); US citizens may stay up to one year.

ALB.free_visa_notes: Most Western, EU, Gulf-resident and many other nationalities enter Albania visa-free for 90 days (US citizens up to 1 year). fees.name: De facto: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) via France or Spain
fees.validity: up to 90 days in 180 (Schengen); Andorra itself imposes no limit via visa
fees.notes: Andorra issues no visas of its own. Entry is only possible through France or Spain, so the standard Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 adults, EUR 45 children 6-11, since 11 June 2024) applies de facto for visa-required nationalities. Apply at a French or Spanish consulate/visa centre.

AND.free_visa_notes: Andorra does not require or issue any visa for entry (official Govern d'Andorra position); a passport (or EU national ID card) suffices. However, Andorra is landlocked between France and Spain and is not in the Schengen Area, so visa-required nationalities need a double- or mult…

fees.name: Tourist visa (consular)
fees.notes: Consular fee is USD 150 or EUR 150 depending on the consular office; payable in local currency of the post. Some embassy schedules (e.g. Embassy in Vietnam) still publish lower legacy amounts, so confirm at the specific consulate.

fees.name: AVE - Autorizacion de Viaje Electronica (electronic travel authorization)
fees.validity: 3 months from issue; 90-day stay, multiple entry, one extension possible
fees.notes: Fee stated as USD 400 on the official Embassy of Argentina in Singapore page; applied for via migraciones.gob.ar/ave. Processing up to 20 business days. Chinese citizens with a valid US visa/green card and Indian/Dominican nationals with equivalent US visas are exempt from needi…

fees.name: Business visa (consular, transitory)
fees.notes: Per Embassy of Argentina in Vietnam transitory-visa schedule: business USD 100; market survey / trade fair USD 50; technical/professional USD 100 (USD 50 for religious activity). Amounts may vary by consular post.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No visa needed if departing within 12 hours of arrival with onward ticket and declared as a transit traveller (must remain in the airport/station). Fee per Embassy in Vietnam schedule; may vary by post.

ARG.free_visa_notes: Nationals of ~90 countries (US, EU, UK, Canada, most of Latin America, etc.) enter visa-free for up to 90 days. The former 'reciprocity fee' for US, Canadian and Australian citizens has been abolished. No fee for visa-exempt travellers.

fees.name: E-Visa — Visitor visa (up to 21 days of stay)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 21 days of stay
fees.notes: Non-refundable fee, published on the official MFA e-visa portal as USD 8 (equivalent to AMD 3,000 in the MFA consular fee table). Extension possible up to 60 extra days at the Migration and Citizenship Service.

fees.name: E-Visa — Visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 120 days of stay
fees.notes: Non-refundable. Portal lists USD 38; MFA consular fee table lists AMD 15,000 / USD 39 for the same category at embassies.

fees.name: Visitor visa at embassy/consulate (up to 21 days of stay)
fees.notes: MFA consular fee table valid from 1 Jan 2026: AMD 3,000 / USD 8 / EUR 7 / RUB 700. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Visitor visa at embassy/consulate (up to 120 days of stay)
fees.notes: AMD 15,000 / USD 39 / EUR 34 / RUB 3,300. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 60 days of stay, 6-month validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 6 months, up to 60 days of stay
fees.notes: AMD 20,000 / USD 52 / EUR 46 / RUB 4,500. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay, 1-year validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 1 year, up to 120 days of stay
fees.notes: AMD 40,000 / USD 103 / EUR 91 / RUB 8,700. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Single-entry transit visa
fees.notes: AMD 10,000 / USD 26 / EUR 23 / RUB 2,200. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple-entry transit visa (1-year validity)
fees.notes: AMD 18,000 / USD 47 / EUR 41 / RUB 4,000. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival at border crossing points
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 21 days (AMD 3,000) or up to 120 days (AMD 15,000)
fees.notes: State-duty amounts mirror the visitor visa schedule (AMD 3,000 for 21 days, AMD 15,000 for 120 days). The current MFA visa page emphasizes the e-visa route and does not restate VOA amounts explicitly, so this row is corroborated by the MFA consular fee schedule plus secondary so…

ARM.free_visa_notes: Not free for everyone, but broad exemptions: nationals of many countries are visa-exempt unilaterally or by agreement (EU/EEA, CIS, and others; lists at mfa.am/en/visafreelist and mfa.am/en/whoneedvisa) and may stay up to 180 days per year. Temporary exemption 1 Jul 2026 – 1 Jul…

fees.name: Tourist Visa on Arrival
fees.notes: US$100.00 or equivalent Eastern Caribbean Currency per passenger, including children. Confirmed on the official Department of Immigration site and by the Antigua and Barbuda Consulate General in New York (abconsulate.nyc).

fees.name: Electronic Entry Visa (EEV) - single entry
fees.notes: The official portal displays the exact fee only inside the application flow (official FAQ: 'click Apply... to find out the e-Visa fee'). USD 100 single-entry is consistently corroborated by multiple secondary sources; treat as indicative until confirmed in the portal. Fee is a n…

fees.name: Electronic Entry Visa (EEV) - multiple entry
fees.notes: USD 200 for 1-year multiple-entry EEV, corroborated by multiple secondary sources; official portal shows the fee inside the application flow. Non-refundable processing fee.

fees.name: Consular/sticker visa (legacy paper process)
fees.notes: The official Visa Fees page (immigration.gov.ag/fees/visa-fees/) currently publishes no fee table; visa issuance has largely moved to the eVisa system and visa-on-arrival. No verifiable consular fee amount found on an official source.

ATG.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (including USA, GBR, CAN, EU, IND per official exempt list) do not need a visa for short tourist stays. Fees above apply only to the relatively small set of visa-required nationalities. No nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule is published; VOA and e-visa…

fees.name: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Tourist stream, applied outside Australia
fees.validity: Stays of up to 3, 6 or 12 months as granted
fees.notes: Base application charge from 1 July 2026 (was AUD 200). Verified via Home Affairs GetPriceList API (subclass 600-29B). Onshore (in-Australia) application is AUD 630. Frequent Traveller stream (eligible passports, e.g. CHN) is AUD 1,845; Sponsored Family and Approved Destination…

fees.name: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Business Visitor stream
fees.notes: Base application charge from 1 July 2026 (subclass 600-31). ETA/eVisitor-eligible passports use those free/cheap options for business visitor activities instead.

fees.name: eVisitor (subclass 651)
fees.validity: 12 months, multiple entries, up to 3 months per stay
fees.notes: Free - AUD 0.00 confirmed via Home Affairs price list API. Tourism or business visitor purposes.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601)
fees.validity: 12 months (or until passport expiry), multiple entries, up to 3 months per stay
fees.notes: No visa application charge (AUD 0.00 in Home Affairs price list); AUD 20 service fee payable in the Australian ETA app, confirmed on official Australian High Commission page. Apply only via the official Australian ETA mobile app.

fees.name: Transit visa (subclass 771)
fees.notes: Free - AUD 0.00 confirmed via Home Affairs price list API.

variations.note: UK and European passport holders use the free eVisitor (651) instead of paying the AUD 250 subclass 600 charge.
US and Canadian passport holders use the ETA (601): no visa charge, AUD 20 app service fee.

vfs.operator: VFS Global (Australian Visa Application Centres; TT Services in some regions)

AUS.free_visa_notes: Australia requires an authority to travel for all non-citizens, but eVisitor (651, European passports) and Transit visa (771) are free, and the ETA (601) costs only a AUD 20 app service fee. Everyone else pays AUD 250 for the offshore Visitor visa (600) from 1 July 2026.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard EU-wide Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 since 11 June 2024). Children 6-12: EUR 45; under 6: free. Austrian Consulate General New York lists USD 103 (adult) / USD 52 (child 6-12), collected in local currency at consulates/VFS.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Type C Schengen visa and fee as tourism; there is no separate business visa fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Type A airport transit visa carries the same fee as Type C under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: National visa (Type D, 91 days - 6 months) - adult
fees.validity: 91 days to 6 months (longer stays not covered by Schengen C)
fees.notes: Austrian national Visa D fee raised from EUR 150 to EUR 195 (adults) / EUR 97 (children under 6) effective 1 July 2025, per Austrian Embassy London. NY consulate lists USD 223 / USD 111. Included because tourists staying >90 days use Visa D; long-term residence/work permits excl…

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Austria has no e-visa; applications are lodged in person at embassies/consulates or VFS Global centres. From late 2026/2027 the EU ETIAS authorisation (EUR 20, ages 18-70) will apply to visa-exempt travellers, but it was not yet in force as of this record date.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Austria does not issue visas on arrival; a Schengen visa must be obtained before travel.

AUT.free_visa_notes: Austria is a Schengen member; citizens of EU/EEA, Switzerland and ~60 visa-exempt countries (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, etc.) enter visa-free for 90/180 days at no cost (until ETIAS EUR 20 comes into force). fees.name: ASAN Visa e-visa (standard, 3 working days)
fees.validity: 90 days validity, single entry, up to 30 days stay
fees.notes: USD 20 state fee + USD 5 mandatory service fee = USD 25 total on the official evisa.gov.az portal (portal itself is bot-protected; state-fee amount confirmed on Embassy of Azerbaijan Washington page).

fees.name: ASAN Visa e-visa (urgent, 3 hours)
fees.validity: 90 days validity, single entry, up to 30 days stay
fees.notes: USD 50 state fee + USD 10 service fee = USD 60 total; urgent e-visa issued within 3 hours including holidays.

fees.name: Single-entry visa (embassy sticker visa, incl. tourist)
fees.validity: typically up to 90 days, single entry
fees.notes: Standard state fee is USD 20 for nearly all nationalities per the MFA country fee schedule; EU-member-state citizens pay EUR 35 under the EU-Azerbaijan visa facilitation agreement (also 35 EUR for Switzerland and Norway); UK/Iceland/Ireland pay GBP 18 at the London embassy.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa (business, private visit, etc.)
fees.validity: multiple entry, duration per visa category

fees.name: Transit visa

fees.name: Visa on arrival

AZE.free_visa_notes: Citizens of several countries (e.g. Russia, Turkey, Georgia, most CIS states) enter Azerbaijan visa-free under bilateral agreements and pay no fee.

fees.name: Entry visa (simple entry, online via migration.gov.bi)
fees.notes: Applied online on the official CGM portal; same fee schedule as visas obtained at embassies or on arrival.

fees.name: Entry visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: Obtainable online, at the airport, or through Burundian embassies.

fees.name: Airport entry visa (visa d'entree aeroport)
fees.notes: CGM portal lists 'Visa d'entree aeroport' as a service; entry-visa tariff is USD 90 per the official fee table. Pre-application online is encouraged.

fees.name: Business travel (uses standard entry visa)
fees.notes: Burundi does not publish a separate business-visa category; business travellers use the standard simple/multiple entry visa (USD 90). Stay extension: USD 10 per 5 days (max 25 days), then USD 70 per month.

variations.note: East African Community citizens: free EAC visa/pass valid 6 months per official CGM tariff table.

BDI.free_visa_notes: Visas are not free generally; EAC member-state citizens receive a free 6-month EAC entry pass and free student visas.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), adults and children 12+
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; children under 6 free. Fee waivers for pupils/students on study trips, researchers, non-profit event participants aged 25 or under, and certain diplomatic passport holders. Paid in EUR (or local-currency equivalent) at submission; non-refundable.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen C-visa fee; no separate business-visa category or price.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen Visa Code fee applies to type A airport transit visas.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, covers Belgium)
fees.notes: Not yet in operation as of 2026-07-02; expected to start in late 2026 after the EU Entry/Exit System. Free for under-18s and over-70s.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Belgium does not issue e-visas; Schengen visas are sticker visas applied for at embassies/consulates or outsourced centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Belgium does not offer visa on arrival; visas must be obtained before travel (exceptional border visas aside).

variations.note: EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement (EUR 35 fee) is suspended since 2022; Russian nationals pay the standard EUR 90 Schengen fee.

fees.notes: Applied online via the official visaburkina.bf portal or through an embassy; hotel reservation required. Fee published as 33,000 F CFA.

fees.name: Embassy-issued visa (Embassy of Burkina Faso, Washington DC)

fees.name: Short-stay Schengen visa (Type C) - tourism/visit
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period

fees.name: e-Visa (pre-enrolled biometric visa, collected at Abidjan airport)

fees.name: Biometric sticker visa (embassy-issued, short stay 1-3 months)

fees.name: Transit

fees.name: Short-stay e-visa (standard processing)

fees.name: Short-stay e-visa (express processing)
fees.notes: Express (approx. 24-72h) processing; EUR 229 equivalent published by High Commission London.

fees.name: Tourist/short-stay visa via embassy (Washington DC published fee)

fees.name: Transit visa (4-30 days)

fees.name: Ordinary visa, multiple entry (embassy-issued)

fees.name: Single-entry visa on arrival

fees.name: Double-entry entry visa

fees.name: Multiple-entry entry visa

fees.name: Transit visa/permit

JOR.free_visa_notes: Visa fee (single entry) is waived for Jordan Pass holders staying at least 2 nights, and for travellers entering via the Aqaba Special Economic Zone. Nationals of most Arab League states enter visa-free.

fees.name: Short-term multiple-entry visa

fees.name: Short-term business visa (single or multiple entry)

fees.name: Transit visa

fees.name: Transit visa, single entry
